texts.094101b5823dbf955db0457cccb7a04b3080dfa4:
:- use_module(library(pita)).
:- pita.
:- begin_lpad.
:- table g_call/5.
:- table lc_call/6.
plc(Ws) :- g_call(['S'] ,Ws,[], [],_Der).
g_call([],L,L,Der,Der).
g_call([G|R], [G|L],L2,Der0,Der) :- terminal(G), g_call(R,L,L2,Der0,Der).
g_call([G|R], [Wd|L] ,L2,Der0,Der) :- \+ terminal(G), first(G,Der0,Wd), lc_call(G,Wd,L,L1,[first(G,Wd)|Der0],Der1), g_call(R,L1,L2,Der1,Der).
lc_call(G,B,L,L1,Der0,Der) :- lc(G,B,Der0,rule(G, [B|RHS2])), attach_or_project(G,Der0,attach), g_call(RHS2,L,L1,[lc(G,B,rule(G, [B|RHS2])),attach|Der0],Der).
lc_call(G,B,L,L2,Der0,Der) :- lc(G,B,Der0,rule(A, [B|RHS2])), attach_or_project(G,Der0,project), g_call(RHS2,L,L1,[lc(G,B,rule(A, [B|RHS2])),project|Der0],Der1), lc_call(G,A,L1,L2,Der1,Der).
lc_call(G,B,L,L2,Der0,Der) :- \+ lc(G,B,Der0,rule(G,[B|_])), lc(G,B,Der0,rule(A, [B|RHS2])), g_call(RHS2,L,L1,[lc(G,B,rule(A, [B|RHS2]))|Der0],Der1), lc_call(G,A,L1,L2,Der1,Der).
attach_or_project(A,Der,Op) :- lc(A,A,Der,_), attach(A,Der,Op).
attach_or_project(A,Der,attach) :- \+ lc(A,A,Der,_).
lc('S','S',_Der,rule('S',['S','S'])).
lc('S',a,_Der,rule('S',[a])).
lc('S',b,_Der,rule('S',[b])).
first('S',Der,a):0.5 ; first('S',Der,b):0.5.
attach('S',Der,attach):0.5 ; attach('S',Der,project):0.5.
terminal(a).
terminal(b).
:- end_lpad.
main :-
    forall((Q = plc([a,a,b,a,b,b,b,b]), prob(Q, P)), format("~q:\t~w~n", [Q, P])).

  first(G,Der0,Wd),
  lc_call(G,Wd,L,L1,[first(G,Wd)|Der0],Der1),
  g_call(R,L1,L2,Der1,Der).
lc_call(G,B,L,L1,Der0,Der) :- lc(G,B,Der0,rule(G, [B|RHS2])),
  attach_or_project(G,Der0,attach),
  g_call(RHS2,L,L1,[lc(G,B,rule(G, [B|RHS2])),attach|Der0],Der).
lc_call(G,B,L,L2,Der0,Der) :- lc(G,B,Der0,rule(A, [B|RHS2])),
  attach_or_project(G,Der0,project),
  g_call(RHS2,L,L1,[lc(G,B,rule(A, [B|RHS2])),project|Der0],Der1),

lc_call(G,B,L,L2,Der0,Der) :- \+ lc(G,B,Der0,rule(G,[B|_])),
  lc(G,B,Der0,rule(A, [B|RHS2])),
  g_call(RHS2,L,L1,[lc(G,B,rule(A, [B|RHS2]))|Der0],Der1),

attach_or_project(A,Der,attach) :- \+ lc(A,A,Der,_).

lc('S',b,_Der,rule('S',[b])).

:- use_module(library(pita)).
:- pita.
:- begin_lpad.
:- table g_call/5.
:- table lc_call/6.
plc(Ws) :- g_call(['S'] ,Ws,[], [],_Der).
g_call([],L,L,Der,Der).
g_call([G|R], [G|L],L2,Der0,Der) :- terminal(G), g_call(R,L,L2,Der0,Der).
g_call([G|R], [Wd|L] ,L2,Der0,Der) :- \+ terminal(G), first(G,Der0,Wd), lc_call(G,Wd,L,L1,[first(G,Wd)|Der0],Der1), g_call(R,L1,L2,Der1,Der).
lc_call(G,B,L,L1,Der0,Der) :- lc(G,B,Der0,rule(G, [B|RHS2])), attach_or_project(G,Der0,attach), g_call(RHS2,L,L1,[lc(G,B,rule(G, [B|RHS2])),attach|Der0],Der).
lc_call(G,B,L,L2,Der0,Der) :- lc(G,B,Der0,rule(A, [B|RHS2])), attach_or_project(G,Der0,project), g_call(RHS2,L,L1,[lc(G,B,rule(A, [B|RHS2])),project|Der0],Der1), lc_call(G,A,L1,L2,Der1,Der).
lc_call(G,B,L,L2,Der0,Der) :- \+ lc(G,B,Der0,rule(G,[B|_])), lc(G,B,Der0,rule(A, [B|RHS2])), g_call(RHS2,L,L1,[lc(G,B,rule(A, [B|RHS2]))|Der0],Der1), lc_call(G,A,L1,L2,Der1,Der).
attach_or_project(A,Der,Op) :- lc(A,A,Der,_), attach(A,Der,Op).
attach_or_project(A,Der,attach) :- \+ lc(A,A,Der,_).
lc('S','S',_Der,rule('S',['S','S'])).
lc('S',a,_Der,rule('S',[a])).
lc('S',b,_Der,rule('S',[b])).
first('S',Der,a):0.5 ; first('S',Der,b):0.5.
attach('S',Der,attach):0.5 ; attach('S',Der,project):0.5.
terminal(a).
terminal(b).
:- end_lpad.
main :-
    forall((Q = plc([a,a,b,a,b,b,b,b,a,a]), prob(Q, P)), format("~q:\t~w~n", [Q, P])).
